question: Which mother goddesses are invoked to protect the practitioner in all directions?
premises: Protection is requested in all directions and intermediate directions.
Brāhmī is named as a protector.
inference: Brāhmī and Nārāyaṇī are invoked to protect the practitioner in every direction.
plain_english: May Brāhmī and likewise Nārāyaṇī protect me in the directions and intermediate directions.
